column1: # Relocation map of recipe/planner-family-20261107/relocate.py (recipe RELOCATE_PLANNER_FAMILY v5). Leaf: the planner family held by consumer-profiles-20261107 (PR #2665): IndexPrecomputePlanner, IndexPrecomputeMultipassCompiler and their closure. Donor: hsoliwal/com.synexia develop 0616288bfa7d91eb0abb754c7a29707f10318752 (2026-11-07). Closure computed from the donor tree (same-package identifiers, imports and qualified references, comments excluded): 25 synexia-index-precompute types + com.synexia.job.IProgressMonitor; the image owners IndexPrecomputeManifestImage and LongTupleIndexImage join so that the three crate tests of the family relocate with it.

# Lineage (develop walk): every main path was last written by 4a2e6452a7ad (2026-10-31). Variants elsewhere in the tree are older: the .superset/conflicts/pr-7973 copies and the owner-scoped-provenance-recipe preimage fixtures (Snapshot, SnapshotBuilder, Manifest, Facet, DependencyImage, MultipassCompiler, DependencyImageTest) and the precompute-startup snapshot postimage 6819480edbf5 (= that preimage); the one newer lineage is NativePrecomputeOps: crate m3-tuple-fallback-scalar-java21-20261102 pins before = the main path (sha256 a0bc481fa4ff...) and postimage 0fbc79832e98 (sha256 b716b3b6f3ed..., arity-specialized Java fallback), so its FILE row reads that postimage.

# Decision: ABSORB into jdk.m3.precompute (m3/ports/precompute) beside the consumer profiles; IndexPrecomputeCapability and IndexPrecomputeWorkload are already relocated by consumer-profiles-20261107 (TYPE rows without FILE rows). Owner check: no M3* name of this map on master, no class FrozenLongTupleIndex|LongTupleIndex|PrecomputeHashes, no TUPLE_PAIR_LOOKUP kernel; the nearest owners are NEC rows (never edited, equivalence not decided).

# Rows: FILE donor -> target (module root m3/ports/precompute); PATCH (v5: target -> the apply recipe that refines it); PACKAGE; TYPE (M3 naming of the module); QUALIFIED (v4: a donor reference written fully qualified in a body -> target expression); LITERAL (string tokens renamed exactly as NAMING_RULES.tsv would: SEGMENT_DOT, SNAKE, CONST); EXTERNAL; NEC and OMIT rows copy nothing (relocate.py logs them as HELD lines).
